name: prisma
description: Teaches coding agents how to work with Prisma 8: edit the data contract, emit artefacts, plan and apply migrations, and write typed db.orm / db.sql queries.

interface.shortDescription: Build with Prisma 8 through its agent skill
interface.longDescription:
Prisma 8 is a contract-first TypeScript data layer. This plugin installs the prisma-8 agent skill already maintained in this repository, so coding agents edit the data contract, run prisma contract emit, plan and apply migrations, and write typed db.orm / db.sql / db.query queries against the version the skill describes.

Use it in projects that depend on @prisma/orm-postgres, @prisma/orm-sqlite, or @prisma/orm-mongo (Prisma 8, formerly Prisma Next): changing contract.prisma or a contract.ts builder, wiring db.ts or middleware, integrating a build tool, using the Supabase extension or RLS, upgrading Prisma 8, or reading a dotted error code such as MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH. Do not use it for Prisma ORM 7 or earlier (schema.prisma + @prisma/client).

The skill ships inside the ORM packages and is also copied with prisma skills sync. This marketplace listing is a second install path for users who want the skill from the repo before or without that sync.
defaultPrompt: Add a User model with a posts relation and emit the Prisma 8 contract
Write a Prisma 8 query that loads each user with their five most recent published posts
Plan a migration after I change the data contract
